subject: Chemistry
title: Solutions
summary: Solution ek homogeneous mixture hai. Iski concentration mass %, ppm, mole fraction, molarity ya molality mein likhte hain.

Gases zyada pressure par zyada ghulti hain (Henry's law) aur aam taur par zyada temperature par kam. Volatile liquids ke liye Raoult's law: har component ka vapour pressure = uska mole fraction × pure vapour pressure.

Ideal solutions Raoult's law bilkul follow karte hain; real solutions positive deviation (kamzor A–B attraction) ya negative deviation (zyada A–B attraction) dikhate hain aur azeotrope bana sakte hain.

Colligative properties sirf solute particles ki sankhya par depend karti hain: relative lowering of vapour pressure, boiling-point elevation, freezing-point depression aur osmotic pressure. van't Hoff factor i dissociation ya association ke liye correction hai.

formulas.name: Henry's law
formulas.formula: p = K_H x  (partial pressure ∝ mole fraction of gas in solution)
formulas.mistake: Bada K_H matlab same pressure par KAM solubility — ulta mat samjho.

formulas.name: Raoult's law (volatile components)
formulas.formula: p_A = x_A p°_A;  p_total = x_A p°_A + x_B p°_B

formulas.name: Vapour composition
formulas.when: Vapour mein component ka mole fraction.
formulas.mistake: Vapour ZYADA volatile component se rich hota hai — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Boiling-point elevation
formulas.mistake: m molality hai (per kg solvent), molarity nahi.

formulas.name: Freezing-point depression
formulas.formula: ΔT_f = i K_f m;  water K_f = 1.86, K_b = 0.52 K kg mol⁻¹

formulas.name: Osmotic pressure
formulas.formula: π = i C R T  (C in mol/L, R = 0.0821 L atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹)
formulas.when: Osmosis, polymers aur proteins ka molar mass.
formulas.mistake: Yahan molarity aur kelvin lo — bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Molar mass from colligative data
formulas.formula: M₂ = (K_b × w₂ × 1000)/(ΔT_b × w₁)  (similarly with K_f);  M₂ = w₂RT/(πV)

formulas.name: van't Hoff factor
formulas.formula: i = observed colligative property / normal value = normal molar mass / observed molar mass

formulas.name: i from dissociation or association
formulas.formula: dissociation into n ions: i = 1 + (n − 1)α;  association into n-mers: i = 1 − (1 − 1/n)α
formulas.mistake: Dimerisation ke liye i = 1 − α/2 — 1 + α mat lo.

topics.title: Types of solutions
topics.explain: Solvent aur solute kisi bhi phase mein: liquid mein gas (soda), liquid mein solid (cheeni), liquid mein liquid (paani mein alcohol), solid mein solid (alloys), solid mein gas (palladium mein H₂).

topics.title: Solubility of solids and gases
topics.explain: Solids: 'like dissolves like'; ghulna endothermic ho to temperature ke saath solubility badhti hai. Gases: pressure se solubility badhti hai (Henry's law) aur temperature se ghatti hai — machhliyon ko thanda paani chahiye, aur divers ko bends hote hain jab ghuli N₂ bubbles bankar nikalti hai.

topics.title: Ideal and non-ideal solutions
topics.explain: Ideal (benzene + toluene): ΔmixH = 0, ΔmixV = 0. Positive deviation (ethanol + acetone, CS₂ + acetone): kamzor A–B forces, ΔmixH > 0, ΔmixV > 0, minimum-boiling azeotrope. Negative deviation (chloroform + acetone, HNO₃ + paani): zyada A–B forces, ΔmixH < 0, ΔmixV < 0, maximum-boiling azeotrope.

topics.title: Azeotropes
topics.explain: Constant-boiling mixtures jo simple distillation se alag nahi hote, jaise 95% ethanol–paani (minimum boiling) aur 68% HNO₃–paani (maximum boiling).

topics.title: Osmosis and reverse osmosis
topics.explain: Solvent semipermeable membrane se dilute se concentrated solution ki taraf jaata hai. Isotonic solutions ka π same (0.9% NaCl blood ke isotonic); RBCs hypotonic mein phoolte aur hypertonic mein sikudte hain. π se zyada pressure lagaao to flow ulta — samundar ka paani meetha karne mein.

topics.title: Abnormal molar masses
topics.explain: Electrolytes dissociate hote hain (i > 1) aur kam apparent molar mass dete hain; benzene mein acetic acid jaise solutes associate hote hain (i < 1) aur zyada apparent molar mass dete hain.

ratta: Henry: p = K_H x (higher K_H → less soluble).
Raoult: p_A = x_A p°_A;  vapour richer in volatile one.
Δp/p° = x₂;  ΔT_b = iK_b m;  ΔT_f = iK_f m;  π = iCRT.
